Name: Heralds of Spring
Author: jjongleee
Description:
[font=Verdana][b][size=3]🌸 About This Mod[/size][/b]
[size=2]Bring the heralds of spring—forsythia Koreana, plum blossoms, and magnolias—into your town and fill it with the beauty of the season.[/size]

[b][size=3]🌿 Included Varieties[/size][/b]
[size=2]- Forsythia Koreana[/size]
[size=2]- Plum Blossom[/size]
[size=2]- Prunus Mume[/size]
[size=2]- Seoljungmae[/size]
[size=2]- Magnolia[/size]
[size=2]- Magnolia Liliiflora[/size]

🌼[size=2]Forsythia Koreana (Gaenari): A bright yellow flower native to Korea, forsythia grows throughout the country and is loved as one of the most familiar signs of spring.[/size]
🌸[size=2]Plum Blossom (Maehwa): Blooming before winter has fully faded, the plum blossom has long been known as a symbol of perseverance and integrity.[/size]
🤍[size=2]Magnolia (Mongnyeon): Its name means “a lotus blooming on a tree,” and it is cherished for its noble and pure elegance.[/size]

[b][size=3]🛠 Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=2]- SMAPI[/size]
[size=2]- Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later[/size]

[b][size=3]📦 Installation[/size][/b]
[size=2]1. Install SMAPI.[/size]
[size=2]2. Install Content Patcher.[/size]
[size=2]3. Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size]
[size=2]4. Launch the game.

[/size][b][size=3]🐛 Reporting Issues[/size][/b]
[size=2]If you encounter any errors, please upload your SMAPI log to [/size][url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url][size=2] and share the link in the Posts tab on the mod page.[/size]
[size=2]This helps me quickly identify and fix the issue. 🙏[/size]

[b][size=3]📝Note:[/size][/b]
[i][size=2]The asset images used in this mod were recreated with AI based on photographs I personally took.[/size]
[/i]

💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜💜

[/size]

[size=3][b]📦 설치 경로[/b][/size]

[size=2]3. 게임을 실행하면 끝![/size]

[size=3][b]🐛 오류 제보[/b][/size]
[size=2]모드 실행 오류시, [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] 에서 오류 로그를 포함하여 게시글에 링크로 남겨주세요. 확인한 후 수정하겠습니다! 🙏
[/size]
